title.en: A packhorse bridge over the beck
title.it: Un ponte di pietra sul ruscello

review: en, sl, it, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

description.en: The village project with Mr Tyson: the beck measured in metres and marked with pegs, thin slate on a pile each side, walls on both banks, long logs dragged from the wood, the arch on its frame, and the bridge ready for the first pony while everyone cheers.
description.sl: Vaški projekt z gospodom Tysonom: potok, izmerjen v metrih in označen s klini, tanek skrilavec na kupu na vsaki strani, zidova na obeh bregovih, dolgi hlodi, privlečeni iz gozda, lok na ogrodju in most, pripravljen za prvega ponija, medtem ko vsi navijajo.
description.it: Il progetto del paese con il signor Tyson: il ruscello misurato in metri e segnato con i picchetti, l'ardesia sottile in un mucchio per lato, muri su tutte e due le rive, lunghi tronchi trascinati dal bosco, l'arco sulla sua armatura e il ponte pronto per il primo pony, mentre tutti fanno festa.
description.de: Das Dorfprojekt mit Mr Tyson: der Bach in Metern ausgemessen und mit Pflöcken markiert, dünner Schiefer auf einem Stapel an jeder Seite, Mauern an beiden Ufern, lange Stämme aus dem Wald geschleift, der Bogen auf seinem Gerüst und die Brücke bereit fürs erste Pony, während alle jubeln.

words.example_en: The beck is six metres wide.
words.example_it: Il ruscello è largo sei metri.
words.example_de: Der Bach ist sechs Meter breit.
words.note: British spelling: metre (American: meter). One metre, six metres.
words.note_sl: Britanski zapis: metre (ameriški: meter). One metre, six metres.
words.note_it: Grafia britannica: metre (americana: meter). One metre, six metres.
words.note_de: Britische Schreibung: metre (amerikanisch: meter). One metre, six metres.

words.example_en: A peg on each bank shows where the bridge will go.
words.example_sl: Klin na vsakem bregu kaže, kje bo most.
words.example_it: Un picchetto su ogni riva mostra dove andrà il ponte.
words.example_de: Ein Pflock an jedem Ufer zeigt, wo die Brücke hinkommt.
words.note: A short wooden stick you hit into the ground. Also the clothes peg on the washing line.
words.note_sl: Kratek lesen kol, ki ga zabiješ v tla. Tudi ščipalka na vrvi za perilo.
words.note_it: Un paletto corto da piantare nel terreno. Anche la molletta del bucato.
words.note_de: Ein kurzer Holzstab, den man in den Boden schlägt. Auch die Wäscheklammer.

words.example_en: Slate splits into thin, flat stones.
words.example_sl: Skrilavec se kolje v tanke ploščate kamne.
words.example_it: L'ardesia si spacca in pietre sottili e piatte.
words.example_de: Schiefer spaltet sich in dünne, flache Steine.
words.note: The opposite: thick. Also of people: not fat.
words.note_sl: Nasprotje: thick (debel). Pri ljudeh: suh, ne debel.
words.note_it: Il contrario: thick (spesso). Per le persone: magro.
words.note_de: Das Gegenteil: thick (dick). Bei Menschen: schlank.

words.example_en: There's a pile of slate on each bank.
words.example_sl: Na vsakem bregu je kup skrilavca.
words.example_it: Su ogni riva c'è un mucchio d'ardesia.
words.example_de: An jedem Ufer liegt ein Stapel Schiefer.

words.example_en: There's a wall on both sides of the beck.
words.example_sl: Na obeh straneh potoka je zid.
words.example_it: C'è un muro su tutti e due i lati del ruscello.
words.example_de: Auf beiden Seiten des Bachs ist eine Mauer.
words.note: The two of them, this one and that one: both banks, both of us.
words.note_sl: Oba, ta in oni: both banks (oba bregova), both of us (midva oba).
words.note_it: Tutti e due, questo e quello: both banks (tutte e due le rive), both of us (noi due).
words.note_de: Alle beide, dieser und jener: both banks (beide Ufer), both of us (wir beide).

words.example_en: There's a wall on each side of the beck.
words.example_sl: Na vsaki strani potoka je zid.
words.example_it: C'è un muro su ogni lato del ruscello.
words.example_de: Auf jeder Seite des Bachs ist eine Mauer.

words.example_en: The logs are seven metres long.
words.example_it: I tronchi sono lunghi sette metri.
words.example_de: Die Stämme sind sieben Meter lang.
words.note: The opposite: short. long, longer, the longest.
words.note_sl: Nasprotje: short (kratek). long, longer, the longest.
words.note_it: Il contrario: short (corto). long, longer, the longest.
words.note_de: Das Gegenteil: short (kurz). long, longer, the longest.

words.example_en: The pony drags the logs to the beck.
words.example_it: Il pony trascina i tronchi fino al ruscello.
words.example_de: Das Pony schleift die Stämme zum Bach.
words.note: To pull something heavy along the ground. I drag, he drags; yesterday we dragged (two g's).
words.note_sl: Vleči nekaj težkega po tleh. I drag, he drags; yesterday we dragged (dva g-ja).
words.note_it: Tirare qualcosa di pesante per terra. I drag, he drags; yesterday we dragged (due g).
words.note_de: Etwas Schweres über den Boden ziehen. I drag, he drags; yesterday we dragged (zwei g).

words.example_en: The packhorse bridge has one round arch.
words.example_sl: Kamniti most ima en okrogel lok.
words.example_it: Il ponte di pietra ha un solo arco tondo.
words.example_de: Die Steinbrücke hat einen runden Bogen.
words.note: One arch, two arches: -es after ch.
words.note_sl: One arch, two arches: -es za ch.
words.note_it: One arch, two arches: -es dopo ch.
words.note_de: One arch, two arches: -es nach ch.

words.example_en: The stones lie on a wooden frame until the arch stands.
words.example_sl: Kamni ležijo na lesenem ogrodju, dokler lok ne stoji.
words.example_it: Le pietre poggiano su un'armatura di legno finché l'arco non sta in piedi.
words.example_de: Die Steine liegen auf einem Holzgerüst, bis der Bogen steht.
words.note: Wood that holds something in shape. Also the frame of a picture or of glasses.
words.note_sl: Les, ki nekaj drži v obliki. Tudi okvir slike ali očal.
words.note_it: Il legno che tiene in forma qualcosa. Anche la cornice di un quadro o la montatura degli occhiali.
words.note_de: Holz, das etwas in Form hält. Auch der Rahmen eines Bildes oder einer Brille.

words.example_en: The bridge is ready for the first pony.
words.example_sl: Most je pripravljen za prvega ponija.
words.example_it: Il ponte è pronto per il primo pony.
words.example_de: Die Brücke ist bereit für das erste Pony.
words.note: Finished and good to use. Are you ready? Ready, steady, go!
words.note_sl: Gotov in za uporabo. Are you ready? Ready, steady, go! (Pozor, pripravljeni, zdaj!)
words.note_it: Finito e pronto per l'uso. Are you ready? Ready, steady, go! (Pronti, partenza, via!)
words.note_de: Fertig und zu gebrauchen. Are you ready? Ready, steady, go! (Auf die Plätze, fertig, los!)

words.example_en: Everyone cheers when the pony is over.
words.example_sl: Vsi navijajo, ko je poni čez.
words.example_it: Tutti fanno festa quando il pony è passato.
words.example_de: Alle jubeln, wenn das Pony drüben ist.
words.note: To shout hooray because you're happy. Also cheers! when you lift your glass, or thanks.
words.note_sl: Vzklikati hura, ker si vesel. Tudi cheers! ob dvigu kozarca ali za hvala.
words.note_it: Gridare evviva perché sei contento. Anche cheers! quando alzi il bicchiere, o per grazie.
words.note_de: Hurra rufen, weil man sich freut. Auch cheers! beim Anstoßen oder als Danke.
